# Statement of Architecture Work — T16 ingestion

## Assignment

The T16 slice (SPEC_V2 §12; issues #85, #448) under the programme's architecture governance: ingest the
organisation's procedure sources as governed, human-reviewed procedures and let a bound job execute them.

## Scope

`procedures.ingest_sop`, `procedures.ingest_rdf`, `procedures.ingest_process`, `procedures.review_source`,
`procedures.publish`, re-ingest versioning and a bound job's PDDL steps. Not in scope: the procedure catalogue
UI (T18) and the process engine (S13).

## Responsibilities

The author job requests and drafts; the approver job decides every gate and is never its requester; the
programme architect owns the contract and the Phase-G review; the BCM owns the benefit.

## Acceptance criteria

SPEC_V2 §12 T16: a real SOP, an OWL file and a BPMN diagram are each ingested end to end; the draft is
published behind a human gate; a re-ingest creates the next draft version while the published row keeps its
source and pack; a job bound to the procedure runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds. Proven by
25/25 tests at lane head `46fc49e2` (transcript `/tmp/u5a-v14/evidence/T16-acceptance.md`).

## Contract

The live delivery contract `01a20a8b-b32c-7185-808f-8ea0b4c5ec46`, requested by the author job and approved by the Architecture
Board under the standing delegation `01a1fb9f-ac2d-732d-b274-1079be3dd2b3`; its Phase-G review is compliant and cites that delegation.
